Unofficial port of Programmer's Typing Practice by climech (MIT).

upstream: https://github.com/climech/typing-practice
license:  MIT (COPYING-typing-practice.txt)

The original is a vanilla-JS page: a never-ending stream of random
characters with weights for lower/upper/digits/punctuation, a hidden
<input> so the real keyboard (including a phone's) is the input, and
no WPM. It stores weights in localStorage.

What this tree keeps:
  the MIT notice
  the charset + random-word drill (letters, digits, punctuation)
  a real input / textarea so the OS keyboard opens — never a fake one

What this tree rewrites:
  the UI (dark, phone layout, passages with a caret)
  persistence (history lives in the icon, not localStorage)
  lessons (home row, then the other rows, then punctuation)
  English and programmer passages, with a toggle
  live WPM + accuracy and a result at the end
  play a friend: same passage, each person writes only their own row

The MIT notice travels INSIDE the GIF as COPYING-typing-practice.txt.
